Plan: Add CSV export to the report dashboard

todo

Type: feature · Created: 2026-06-10 · Repo: agentics (fixture)

Objective

Add a one-click CSV export to the report dashboard so users can download the currently filtered report rows as a spreadsheet-ready file.

Steps

Step 1 — Add the export endpoint

Create GET /api/reports/:id/export.csv in server/routes/reports.js that streams the filtered report rows as CSV with a Content-Disposition: attachment header.

Verify: curl the endpoint for a known report and confirm the response has a text/csv content type and one line per record.

Step 2 — Escape CSV field values

In server/lib/csv.js, quote fields containing commas, quotes, or newlines, and double embedded quotes per RFC 4180 so values like Acme, Inc. round-trip correctly.

Verify: check it works.

Step 3 — Add the Export button to the dashboard

Add an "Export CSV" button to src/components/ReportToolbar.jsx that links to the export endpoint with the current filter query string.

Verify: click the button on a filtered dashboard and confirm the downloaded file contains only the filtered rows.

Acceptance Criteria

  • The export endpoint returns a CSV download for any saved report.
  • The Export CSV button is visible on the report dashboard toolbar.
  • The downloaded file reflects the dashboard's active filters.
